c74object.name: evi_control_lpg_buchla
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Envelope and control circuit wrapper for voltage control of Rf
c74object.description:
evi_control_lpg_buchla is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
Analog modelled vactrol envelope and control circuit for the voltage control of the evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction evi.lpg~.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ ping, offset, scale, sweep } }

geninlet.name: ping
geninlet.digest: Ping the control circuit. Once connected to an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) audio rate ping to attack the filter gate.

geninlet.name: offset
geninlet.digest: @default 0.. 0..1 Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: scale
geninlet.digest: @default 0.5. 0..1 Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: sweep
geninlet.digest: @default 0.7. 0..1 Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

attribute.name: offsetsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 2) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: override
attribute.description: A special option that simplifies the LPG interaction. If set to on (1) the vactrol envelope controls all 'control inlets' (inlets 2, 3 and 4). This forces a classic LPG sound in a simple way. Typically, when using this feature, one would switch inlets 2, 3 and 4 to zero and control the circuit only via the @vactrol... attributes. However, the vactrol 'override' control is summed with the control inlets, so interesting effects can be achieved by utilising 'scale' (inlet 3) and 'sweep' (inlet 4) simultaneously (but 'offset' - inlet 2 - is easier to use if set to zero with the 'override' feature on, although there is no harm in trying). If @override is off (the default), the LPG behaves as normal, with the control inlets only tuned by the values at their inputs.

attribute.name: response
attribute.description: Select 0, 1, 2. Subtle. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper. It is only noticeable with high control (and filter resonance) settings

attribute.name: scalesmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 3) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: sweepsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: vactrolfall
attribute.description: Ping decay time in samples. This refers to the voltage release time. The audible decay of the control circuit is longer.

attribute.name: vactrolgate
attribute.description: Amount of time (set in ms) to 'hold' the (rectangular) triggered on/off gate addressing the vactrol envelope. Zero = 1-sample click. 0, 1, 2, 3 are special values that allow for repeat triggering increasing amplitude. Values 4..20 result in a very predictable vactrol envelope. Higher values cause a held clamping of the envelope attack.

attribute.name: vactrolmapdamp
attribute.description: Low shelving filter damp, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Under the right settings, this attribute can have a strong affect on the attack feeling of the gate voltage. A higher damping value 'softens' the attack at the filter stage rather than in the envelope stage. This can add a squidgy sound the is rather cool. The mapping filter frequency is set by the @vactrolmaphz attribute.

attribute.name: vactrolmaphz
attribute.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). Typically this would be set to low Hz values (perhaps 5..20) for maximum effect. This filter mapping is controlled by the @vactrolmapdamp attribute and is by default off.

attribute.name: vactrolrise
attribute.description: Ping attack time in samples. Because this is an analog modelled vactrol, the attack time has a strong affect on envelope range and sweep. Slower attack times may silence the control circuit alltogether if @vactrolscalar or the three control inlets are set to low values. Most useful in range 1..20

attribute.name: vactrolscalar
attribute.description: Scale the output amplitude of the vactrol envelope at the beginning of the ping chain. Very different behaviours can be achieved by modifying this in combination with careful tuning if the Rise/Fall attributes. Scaling behaviour is also achieved with the 'Offset', 'Scale' and 'Sweep' controls (inlets 2, 3 and 4). However, it is possible to keep those control values low and this attribute high to achieve a different sort of LPG effect. This attribute also requires retuning when using the @override attribute feature.

attribute.name: vactrolshape
attribute.description: Transform the vactrol envelope shape between flat ('0') and sharp ('1'). This has a radical affect on the sound of the ping. Higher values also accentuate the attack stage and increase the amplitude of the envelope hitting the LPG, especially if @vactrolgate is low.
